beats.headline: The safe room has rules
beats.text: Folks down here are carrying things we need, and the monsters on these first floors are hardly worth the trouble. A person is worth a good deal more. Maggie and I have eight between us. So we try it in a safe room, on a man with a cat, and the room has rules about that: you pull the trigger and you freeze where you stand while it lectures you. First time we did it that way. It will be the last.

beats.headline: Maggie does the talking
beats.text: The show plays our whole road for the young man and the cat, out of order, and he watches his own present go off in our faces. He says she wasn't dead yet. Maggie goes at him with the dagger and finds the trailer wall instead, and tells him she's going to find him and watch him die, him and the cat. I don't say a word. Then the orc hands us a Legendary Skill Potion: Find Crawler to fifteen, any name, anywhere. Maggie holds it to her chest, and for the first time, she smiles.

beats.headline: Level seventeen at station 101
beats.text: Level seventeen, night elf, blood assassin, and I don't remember picking any of it. I was that drunk; I think the tentacled fella picked it for me. Haven't seen Maggie since the end of the second floor. We fought about the young man and his cat, and I think she blocked me. The folks I fell in with on the third floor ditched me once I told them the truth, and the new bunch on the train wanted nothing to do with a man wearing skulls. So I got off at 101, found this bar, and stayed. Tonight I gave the young man our ring. That's my revenge.

beats.headline: Chris, at the bar
beats.text: Frank Q stays at the bar. A crawler talks with him; they fight; the other crawler kills him, walks out, and is banned from the club. The Sledge reports it to the cat by chat. The killer is Chris, of the Meadow Lark group, a rock monster of a different kind from the Sledge. The last thing Frank Q said to the barefoot crawler, as he slipped the ring on, was vengeance is mine.

beats.headline: A Scree riding Chris Andrews
beats.text: Frank Q is dead. Chris Andrews killed him, and Chris Andrews was not the one driving. Maggie My is back in the dungeon as a Scree, riding inside another crawler, and Frank died of exactly the thing he brought down here with him. He found Carl at the Desperado Club and gave him a ring. She found Frank there afterwards. Half of a pair who taught this planet what safe rooms are for. The other half is still walking around, wearing somebody else.

beats.headline: Maggie My, pulled out at last
beats.text: Maggie My is dead. Carl, phased by a potion, reached into Chris Andrews's head and pulled her out, and she burrowed into Carl instead, because of course she did. A second potion threw her back out through his neck, and Mongo finished her. So that is both of them, Frank and Maggie. Eight skulls between them by the first safe room, and the file is closed.

beats.headline: Leveled-Up, Sober Edition
beats.text: The goddess plays a Raid Stash, and five cards come flying out of five decks. One of them is the only inactive totem the cat was carrying, and that's me. Leveled-Up Frank, Sober Edition, a level 100 night elf blood assassin, landing on a roof that is coming apart underneath all of us, folks. And there's the young man. Hello, Carl. Fancy seeing you here. Where's your ring? The cat sends her tentacle cloud at me, and I pull the red sword off my shoulder.
